issue: The shared formatRadical renders a zero distance as √0. It special-cases a radicand of 1 but not 0, so d(P,P) displays as √0 rather than 0.
whyDeferred: No project-wide invariant requires canonical zero display. The only precedent is a code comment in straightLine.ts — 'A zero distance is zero, with no radical left hanging beside it' — which normalises inside that module's own simplifier, with no test and no stated policy. Changing the shared formatter would reach Classes 9 and 10 on no mandate.
localActionTaken: distance3D normalises zero inside its own simplifier, following the straightLine precedent. This touches no other grade.
semanticGateUnaffected: distanceSquared3D(P,P).num is 0 and distance3D(P,P).coefficient.num is 0; the mathematical identity test asserts the value, not the typography.
futureAction: A shared canonical-format decision with an explicit policy and Class 9/10 regressions.
